diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_lambda_function.scale_up can be invoked by its SQS event source mapping before :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.scale_up is created (the log group is currently ordered after the function because its name references the function name). On first invocation Lambda auto-creates /aws/lambda/<function_name> without the configured retention_in_days/kms_key_id/log_group_class, and the managed log group create then fails with "already exists". The function should be created after its log group.

:resource.aws_lambda_function.scale_down is triggered by aws_cloudwatch_event_rule.scale_down and could run before :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.scale_down is created (the log group is currently ordered after the function because its name references the function name). Lambda would auto-create the log group without the configured retention/kms/log_class settings, and the managed log group create would then fail. The function should depend on its log group.
